Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management, especially for your deeply underwater leveraged positions, given the current market headwinds.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to reduce exposure to leveraged decay and deep losses; their current stops are far from current prices.
Respect the stop on SMCI at 37.3 to prevent further losses on this position.
